tools.name: search_stops
tools.description: Find transit stops and stations by stop number, stop code, or name from the static GTFS feeds. Searches both the TTC and Hamilton HSR by default and merges the results; pass agency to search one agency only. Every result carries an agency field (TTC or HSR).

tools.name: next_departures
tools.description: Get the next departures for one stop on the TTC or Hamilton HSR. Static schedule candidates from the persistent schedule store are merged with GTFS Realtime trip updates (BusTime for the TTC, the City of Hamilton feed for HSR), and realtime entries replace matching scheduled entries. tools.name: service_alerts
tools.description: Get currently active service alerts. Defaults to the TTC, optionally filtered by mode to subway, bus, streetcar, or accessibility alerts; the mode filter applies to TTC alerts only. Pass agency hsr for Hamilton HSR alerts, or agency all for both agencies combined.

tools.name: route_vehicles
tools.description: Get live vehicle positions for one route from the agency GTFS Realtime vehicle positions feed. Pass agency to resolve the route inside one agency. Without agency the TTC is tried first and HSR second, so a route name that exists in both returns the TTC vehicles.
